'''Brendan Schieler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 San Antonio tournament]] on 15 January 2000, according to Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d176">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-15-san-antonio-texas-1-15-00d176/ san-antonio-texas-1-15-00], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 15 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-15-san-antonio-texas-1-15-00d176/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
